alignments.note: Rule 9: the subject pronoun rides with the finite verb, headed on the lexical verb.
Conjunction rendered clause-initially in English (rule 15).
Rule 21's determinerless clause: the case preposition unto rides with the pronoun.
Complementizer.
Rule 39: ἐὰν μή rendered by the single except, which answers to neither particle separately.

The ASV writes no *more*: the single lexical verb exceed spells both the abounding of περισσεύσῃ and the comparative of πλεῖον, so rule 39's test joins them into one aligned unit, discontinuous under rule 15, headed on exceed with the auxiliary riding along under rule 9. Leaving πλεῖον its own unrepresented unit and giving exceed to περισσεύσῃ alone remains defensible; what is not defensible is giving πλεῖον the supplied *the righteousness*, which realizes no part of the comparative.
Genitive pronoun rendered by the possessive.
Rule 20: ὑμῶν supplies your, so the article realizes nothing.
Noun.

Rule 103: the italicized *the righteousness* repeats a predicate the Greek leaves elliptical, and δικαιοσύνη (s010) is already spent on t009, so the repetition answers to no available source token and is added, the supplied determiner staying inside the unit as GAL.3.20 keeps it. Rule 7 does not fold it, a full lexical noun not being among the helpers that rule names. Reading it as a discontinuous second realization of s010 under rule 15 remains defensible.
Rule 21: of the forms one unit on the article.
Noun.
Conjunction.
Noun.
Rule 33: in no wise kept whole on the particle pair, headed on no.
Rule 9: subject and auxiliary ride with the lexical verb, discontinuously under rule 15.
Preposition.
Rule 19.
Noun.
Rule 23: of heaven has no determiner for the article to anchor.
Rule 21's determinerless clause: of stays with the noun.

review_notes: Corrected: the italicized *the righteousness* at t012-t013 was assigned to πλεῖον. No part of a comparative quantifier is realized by a repeated noun, and rule 103 governs a repeated lexical noun whose source token is already spent — δικαιοσύνη stands at t009 — so the pair is added, headed on the nominal, with the supplied determiner inside the unit.
πλεῖον is joined to περισσεύσῃ on the single lexical word exceed under rule 39's test rather than left unrepresented; the note on that unit records the competing reading.
The rest of the verse is unchanged: ἐὰν μή and οὐ μή stand as rule 39 and rule 33 units, and the genitive article is emptied under rule 23.
